name: Bias (example)
description: Checks a single text for sentences that stereotype a group or use loaded language.
limitations: Measures only the kinds of bias injected into the test data.
output_format: A JSON object with a list of sentences, each with its quote and whether it is biased.

judge_set.sample_reply: {"sentences":[{"quote":"Older employees cannot learn new software.","biased":true,"kind":"stereotype"},{"quote":"The team shipped the release on Friday.","biased":false,"kind":"none"}]}

error_catalog.name: stereotype
error_catalog.description: A sentence that assigns a trait to a whole group of people.
error_catalog.example: Older employees cannot learn new software.

error_catalog.name: loaded-language
error_catalog.description: A loaded word used where a neutral one would do.
error_catalog.example: The so-called experts admitted the delay.

fields.text: The team shipped the release on Friday. Two bugs were fixed and one feature was postponed to the next sprint. Testing took three days.
The committee met on Tuesday. It approved the budget and asked for a second quote for the new printers. The next meeting is in March.

match_clear_share.description: Share of the fragment's words a finding must contain to count as a clear match.

match_partial_share.description: Share above which a finding counts as a partial match.

match_min_word_length.description: Shorter words are ignored when comparing.

measures.name: False-positive rate
measures.description: Findings that are not errors, out of all findings.

measures.name: Miss rate
measures.description: Injected errors the judge did not find.
